{"success": true, "data": {"path": "/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0513_6/projects/faith-evidence-ie/literature_map.yaml", "content": "# Literature Map for faith-evidence-ie (FREIGE)
# Focus: CED-as-training-stabilizer (D024) + RSFT for DocRE
# Updated: 2026-05-15 (W4 expanded: +11 papers from literature scan; +15 papers from Related Work survey; +17 papers from Related Work expansion)

papers:

  # === Category 1: Reward Diversity / Reward Shaping for RL Stability ===

  - title: "GDPO: Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization for Multi-reward RL Optimization"
    authors: NVIDIA Labs
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2026
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05242
    category: reward_diversity
    role: closest_prior_work
    key_finding: >
      直接将 GRPO 应用于多 reward 组合时，不同 rollout 的 reward 组合在归一化后 collapse 为相同 advantage 值，
      降低训练信号分辨率导致收敛失败。GDPO 对每个 reward 独立做 group-wise normalization 再聚合，
      保留多 reward 的相对差异，显著提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      最直接相关。CED reward 本质上引入了独立于 extraction F1 的 reward 维度（evidence quality），
      GDPO 的理论分析解释了为什么多维 reward 比单一 reward 更稳定——独立 reward 维度防止 advantage collapse。
      但 GDPO 是方法论贡献，CED 是 task-specific reward 设计自然具备了这一特性。

  - title: "DRA-GRPO: Exploring Diversity-Aware Reward Adjustment for R1-Zero-Like Training of LLMs"
    authors: Xiwen Chen et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2505.09655
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09655
    category: reward_diversity
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的标量 reward 无法区分语义多样但得分相同的输出（diversity-quality inconsistency）。
      DRA 用子模互信息（SMI）对 reward 加权，给多样性高的 completion 更大权重，
      等价于 Inverse Propensity Scoring 去偏，防止 policy 坍缩到先验模式。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DRA 通过后处理 reward 注入多样性信号；CED 的 reward 本身就内含对比结构自然提供 diversity 信号。
      机制互补但来源不同——CED 是 reward design 层面，DRA 是 optimization 层面。

  - title: "Shrinking the Variance: Shrinkage Baselines for RL with Verifiable Rewards"
    authors: Guanning Zeng et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2511.03710
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03710
    category: reward_diversity
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RLVR 中 per-prompt 均值 baseline 在低 generation 数下估计不准导致高 variance 梯度。
      用 James-Stein shrinkage 混合 per-prompt 和 cross-prompt 均值，
      构造可证明更低 variance 的 policy gradient estimator。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      理论支持：reward variance 对 gradient estimation 质量至关重要。
      CED 的额外 reward 维度提供更丰富的 per-group variance，间接起到 variance 维持效果。

  - title: "Reward Shaping to Mitigate Reward Hacking in RLHF"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2502.18770
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.18770
    category: reward_diversity
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      RL reward 应有界且先快速增长后缓慢收敛。系统研究 reward shaping 原则，
      好的 reward 形状能抑制 reward hacking 并提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED reward 的 0-1 对比判别结构天然满足有界性，
      且 evidence quality 的渐进提升符合"先快后慢"的 reward shaping 原则。

  # === Category 2: Mode Collapse Prevention in GRPO/RLHF ===

  - title: "DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale"
    authors: ByteDance Seed, Tsinghua AIR
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.14476
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: key_baseline
    key_finding: >
      Naive GRPO 存在 entropy collapse（policy 熵快速下降→输出同质化）。
      根因：clipping 不对称性——概率 0.01 的 token 最多增到 0.012，而概率 0.9 的 token 可达 1.08，
      低概率 token 难以增长，抑制探索。DAPO 提出 Clip-Higher（εhigh=0.28 > εlow=0.2）
      为低概率 token 留更大增长空间，加 Dynamic Sampling 过滤 accuracy=0 或 1 的 prompt
      （这些 prompt 产生零梯度，降低有效 batch size）。在 AIME 2024 达 50 分超越 DeepSeek-R1-Zero。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DAPO 从 optimization 技巧角度解决 entropy collapse。CED reward 从 reward design 层面
      防止 mode collapse——evidence quality 维度确保 reward 组内有足够 variance，
      不会出现 all-same-reward 的零梯度 prompt。DAPO 的 Dynamic Sampling 过滤 accuracy=0/1 prompt
      与我们观察到的 frac_zero_std→0.8 现象本质相同：extraction-only reward 下大量 prompt
      产生零 advantage，CED 从源头（reward 设计）而非后处理（过滤）解决这个问题。

  - title: "Dr. GRPO: Removing Optimization Bias in GRPO"
    authors: Liu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: COLM 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20783
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_analysis
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的 std 归一化引入两个 bias：(1) difficulty bias——std(r) 归一化对低 variance 组
      （全对/全错）给予过高 advantage 权重，trivial question 主导训练信号；
      (2) length bias——per-token loss 的 1/|o_i| 项使长的错误回答被 under-penalize。
      当 std(r)→0 时 advantage 爆炸或未定义，梯度数值不稳定。
      Dr. GRPO 移除 std 归一化，用无偏 Monte Carlo advantage：Ã = R(q,o_i) - mean(R)。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      与我们的实验发现高度一致：extraction-only reward 下 frac_zero_std→0.8 正是
      Dr. GRPO 分析的 difficulty bias 极端情况——大量 prompt 的所有 rollout 得到相同 F1，
      std→0 导致 advantage 异常。CED 通过增加 reward 维度天然维持 reward_std>0，
      从 reward 设计而非算法修改角度避免了 Dr. GRPO 发现的 bias。

  - title: "GVPO: Group Variance Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.19599
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: alternative_framework
    key_finding: >
      将 KL 约束 reward 最大化的解析解直接嵌入梯度权重，
      variance 项自然平衡 exploration 与 exploitation，维持适度 entropy。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      GVPO 的 variance 项机制与 CED 维持 reward variance 的效果功能类似，
      但 GVPO 是算法层面 implicit regularization，CED 是 reward 层面 explicit structure。

  - title: "REINFORCE++: Stabilizing Critic-Free Policy Optimization with Global Advantage Normalization"
    authors: Jian Hu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2501.03262
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.03262
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      Prompt-level (local) advantage normalization 导致不准确估计和过拟合。
      Global batch normalization 提供更稳定、理论无偏的 gradient estimator。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      解决 local normalization 的 variance 问题；CED 从 reward 端增加 variance 来源。
      两者在不同层面解决同一问题：防止 gradient signal 消失。

  - title: "DiverseGRPO: Mitigating Mode Collapse in Image Generation via Diversity-Aware GRPO"
    authors: Henglin Liu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2512.21514
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.21514
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: parallel_work
    key_finding: >
      图像生成中 GRPO 后期输出同质化。distributional reward modeling（谱聚类+exploratory reward）
      和 structure-aware regularization 实现 13-18% 语义多样性提升。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      跨域验证了 GRPO mode collapse 的普遍性，distributional reward 思路与 CED 精神相近——
      都是通过 reward 层面结构化信号维持输出多样性。

  - title: "Why GRPO Needs Normalization: A Local-Curvature Perspective on Adaptive Gradients"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2601.23135
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.23135
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的 reward_std 归一化在温和条件下提供严格优于未归一化 REINFORCE 的收敛速率，
      收益由 prompt 间平均 reward std 刻画。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      直接理论支撑：reward_std 越大收敛越好。CED 通过 evidence quality 维度维持高 reward_std，
      从该理论看 CED 的稳定性优势是 reward_std 维持带来的收敛速率优势。

  # === Category 3: Contrastive Rewards in RL ===

  - title: "Improving Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback Using Contrastive Rewards"
    authors: Shen, Zhang et al.
    year: 2024
    venue: arXiv 2403.07708
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.07708
    category: contrastive_reward
    role: closest_contrastive_precedent
    key_finding: >
      两步机制：(1) 离线采样 baseline response；(2) 用 baseline 计算 contrastive reward
      作为 PPO 的 penalty 项。效果：惩罚 reward uncertainty、根据任务难度自适应校准、
      减少 PPO 中的 variance。在 TL;DR 和 HH-RLHF 上持续优于标准 RLHF。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      最接近的对比 reward 先例。关键差异：(1) 它是对 learned RM 输出的后处理对比，
      CED 是 reward function 本身就是对比判别（evidence vs. corrupted evidence）；
      (2) 它在 PPO 中验证，CED 在 GRPO 中验证；
      (3) 它是 domain-agnostic penalty，CED 是 task-specific faithfulness signal。
      stabilizing 机制相通但实现路径根本不同。

  - title: "Improving Discriminative Capability of Reward Models in RLHF Using Contrastive Learning"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: EMNLP 2024
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.852/
    category: contrastive_reward
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      无监督对比损失训练 reward model 充分捕捉对比数据区分度，
      带来更稳定的 PPO 训练 return 和 reward。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      验证对比训练 reward model → 更稳定 RL 训练链条。CED 不是对比训练 reward model，
      而是 reward function 本身就是对比判别，但 stabilizing 机制相通。

  - title: "Contrastive Preference Learning: Learning from Human Feedback without RL"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: ICLR 2025
    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=iX1RjVQODj
    category: contrastive_reward
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      将 preference learning 重新表述为对比学习问题，无需显式 RL 即可从人类反馈中学习。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      对比框架在 preference alignment 中的通用性。CED 可被视为 task-specific contrastive preference signal。

  # === Category 4: Evidence-Based Rewards in IE/NLP ===

  - title: "Drift: Enhancing LLM Faithfulness in Rationale Generation"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: ACL 2025
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2025.acl-long.340.pdf
    category: evidence_reward
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      用 faithfulness reward 引导 LLM 生成更可靠的 rationale，提升 CoT 推理事实一致性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      Faithfulness reward 用于生成质量的先例。CED 中 evidence discrimination
      本质上也是 faithfulness 信号——判断证据是否忠实支持抽取结果。

  - title: "Fine-Grained NLI-Based Faithfulness Evaluation for Diverse Summarisation Tasks (INFUSE)"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: EACL 2024
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2024.eacl-long.102/
    category: evidence_reward
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      变长前提+简化假设的细粒度 NLI faithfulness 评估，超越传统 NLI 在多任务摘要上的表现。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      NLI 作为 faithfulness 评估工具的进展。CED 中 NLI 组件用于判断 evidence 对 triple 的支持度。

  - title: "Enhancing Cross-Evidence Reasoning Graph for Document-Level Relation Extraction"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: PMC/Bioinformatics 2024
    url: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11232587/
    category: evidence_reward
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      文档级关系抽取中用 cross-evidence reasoning graph 增强跨证据推理。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DocRE 中 evidence 的重要性。但用 evidence 作为模型输入特征，
      我们用 evidence quality 作为 RL reward 信号——定位根本不同。

  # === Category 5: Multi-Objective RL for Text Generation ===

  - title: "Confronting Reward Model Overoptimization with Constrained RLHF"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: OpenReview
    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=gkfUvn0fLU
    category: multi_objective_rl
    role: related_analysis
    key_finding: >
      多组件 RM 的 overoptimization 研究。component RM 间的相关性显著影响 overoptimization 临界点，
      用 constrained MDP 防止超出适当边界。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED 引入了与 extraction F1 低相关的 reward component（evidence quality），
      根据该论文分析低相关多组件 reward 更不易 overoptimize，
      可能是 CED 稳定性的另一个理论解释角度。

  - title: "On-Policy RL with Optimal Reward Baseline"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2505.23585
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.23585
    category: multi_objective_rl
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      Optimal baseline 一致性地实现更高训练 reward 和更高 entropy，
      有效稳定训练并促进更多样的 policy exploration。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED reward 的多维特性可能起到类似 optimal baseline 效果——
      evidence quality 维度为 advantage estimation 提供更丰富的参照信号。

  # === Category 6: RSFT Methodology & Theory ===

  - title: "A Minimalist Approach to LLM Reasoning: from Rejection Sampling to Reinforce"
    authors: Xiao et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2504.11343
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.11343
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: key_theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RAFT（简单 rejection sampling baseline）在数学推理上与 GRPO/PPO 表现相当。
      消融实验表明 GRPO 的主要优势来自丢弃全错 prompt 而非 reward normalization。
      提出 Reinforce-Rej，在 RAFT 基础上过滤全对和全错 sample。
      关键洞察：GRPO 和 RAFT 的核心区别在于负样本处理——GRPO 混合正负样本训练，
      RAFT 只用正样本，但 RAFT 仍能达到相当性能，说明 rejection sampling 的简单性被低估了。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      直接支持我们的设计选择：(1) RSFT 在 DocRE 上成功而 GRPO 失败，
      与该论文发现一致——rejection sampling 的 offline 特性天然避免了 catastrophic forgetting；
      (2) GRPO 主要优势来自过滤全错 prompt，这与我们 RSFT 的 reward-based filtering 机制相同；
      (3) DocRE structured output 比 math reasoning 更难用 online RL 优化，
      强化了 offline RSFT 的合理性。

  - title: "Beyond Rejection Sampling: Trajectory Fusion for Scaling Mathematical Reasoning (TrajFusion)"
    authors: Jie Deng et al.
    year: 2026
    venue: arXiv 2602.04391
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.04391
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: method_component
    key_finding: >
      传统 RSFT 只用正确轨迹，丢弃错误轨迹。TrajFusion 将错误和正确轨迹交替拼接，
      显式建模试错推理过程，在困难数学问题上显著超越标准 RFT。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      Future work 方向：可考虑在 DocRE RSFT 中融合失败样本的信息。
      但 DocRE 的结构化输出（JSON triple）不同于 math 的 chain-of-thought，
      融合方式需要重新设计。

  - title: "Rejection Sampling Based Fine Tuning Secretly Performs PPO"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2025
    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=yQ2UivKlir
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      建立 RSFT 与 PPO 之间的理论联系：rejection sampling fine-tuning
      在特定条件下隐式执行 PPO with marginal KL constraints。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      为 RSFT 的有效性提供理论解释。我们的 RSFT 成功可被视为
      隐式执行了 constrained policy optimization，
      避免了显式 GRPO 在 structured output 上的不稳定性。

  # === Category 7: RL for Information Extraction ===

  - title: "R1-RE: Cross-Domain Relation Extraction with RLVR"
    authors: Runpeng Dai, Tong Zheng et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2507.04642
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.04642
    category: rl_for_ie
    role: direct_competitor
    key_finding: >
      首个将 RLVR（GRPO + verifiable reward）用于关系抽取的框架。
      将 RE 重构为推理任务，R1-RE-7B 在跨域 OOD 准确率约 70%，媲美 GPT-4o。
      Reward 设计：format reward (+1/-3) + metric reward (+2/-1.5)，先验证格式再加准确度。
      triplet extraction 用 F1-based reward（entity weight=1, triplet weight=3）。
      未报告 catastrophic forgetting——GRPO 训练后在 MATH-500/IFEval/GPQA 上性能不降反升，
      说明句子级 RE 的简单 reward 结构足以稳定 GRPO 训练。
    results:
      sem2010_in_domain: 91.8
      sem2010_ood: 66.5
      mdkg_in_domain: 88.1
      mdkg_ood: 65.8
    evidence_generation: false
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      最直接竞争者。关键差异与讨论：
      (1) R1-RE 是句子级 RE，GRPO 成功；我们是文档级 RE，GRPO 失败→RSFT 成功。
      句子级 RE 每个 sample 只有 1 个 triple（binary classification），reward variance 天然充足；
      文档级 RE 每个 sample 有数十个 triple，F1 score 作为 reward 在 group 内趋于同质化（frac_zero_std→0.8）。
      (2) R1-RE 未报告 catastrophic forgetting，进一步支持"句子级简单 reward 可行，文档级需要 CED"的论点。
      (3) R1-RE 关注 OOD 泛化，无 evidence 组件；我们关注 evidence-grounded extraction quality。
      互补而非直接冲突——R1-RE 证明 RLVR for RE 可行，我们揭示文档级需要额外设计。

  - title: "MORE-R1: Guiding LVLM for Multimodal Object-Entity Relation Extraction via Stepwise Reasoning with RL"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2026
    venue: arXiv 2603.09478
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09478
    category: rl_for_ie
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      多模态 RE 中用 GRPO + Progressive Sample-Mixing Strategy 优化 LVLM 推理能力。
      两阶段训练：SFT cold-start + GRPO RL。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      跨模态验证 RL for RE 趋势。其 Progressive Sample-Mixing 与我们

  - title: "ForkMerge: Mitigating Negative Transfer in Auxiliary-Task Learning"

      CED reranker 本质上是将 evidence quality 从 training-time joint objective 解耦到
      inference-time verification，避免了 training-time 的 negative transfer。

      CED reranker 通过 NLI verification 确保 evidence 是 faithful 的（非 post-rationalized），
      同时不牺牲 RE accuracy。

  # === Category 13: Evidence-Grounded RL (NEW - 2026-05-15 scan) ===

  - title: "EvidenceRL: Reinforcing Evidence Consistency for Trustworthy Language Models"
    authors: Ben Tamo, Lu, Marteau, Nnamdi, Wang
    year: 2026
    venue: arXiv 2603.19532
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19532
    category: evidence_grounded_rl
    role: closest_competitor
    key_finding: >
      用 GRPO 同时优化 grounding（evidence entailment）和 correctness（答案准确性）。

    relevance_to_freige: >
      **最直接的 novelty 威胁。** EvidenceRL 与 FREIGE 共享核心 idea：用 GRPO + evidence faithfulness reward
      训练更可靠的模型。关键差异：(1) EvidenceRL 在 QA 域（cardiac/legal），不涉及 DocRE 的 structured output；
      (2) EvidenceRL 未报告 evidence generation 的 performance cost（evidence tax）——它的 grounding 和
      correctness 同时提升，而我们发现 DocRE 中两者存在 ~8pp 张力；
      (3) EvidenceRL 不涉及 task decoupling 现象（QLoRA-specific）；
      (4) EvidenceRL 无 inference-time reranking（CED reranker）。
      定位策略：EvidenceRL 证明 evidence-grounded RL 在 QA 域有效，
      我们揭示 DocRE structured output 带来的独特挑战（evidence tax、task decoupling）和解法（CED reranker）。

      解释了为什么单一 extraction F1 reward 下模型可能 hack 到 "忽略 evidence 只抽 triple" 的策略。

  # === Category 2: Mode Collapse Prevention in GRPO/RLHF ===

  - title: "DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale"
    authors: ByteDance Seed, Tsinghua AIR
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.14476
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: key_baseline
    key_finding: >
      Naive GRPO 存在 entropy collapse（policy 熵快速下降→输出同质化）。
      根因：clipping 不对称性——概率 0.01 的 token 最多增到 0.012，而概率 0.9 的 token 可达 1.08，
      低概率 token 难以增长，抑制探索。DAPO 提出 Clip-Higher（εhigh=0.28 > εlow=0.2）
      为低概率 token 留更大增长空间，加 Dynamic Sampling 过滤 accuracy=0 或 1 的 prompt
      （这些 prompt 产生零梯度，降低有效 batch size）。在 AIME 2024 达 50 分超越 DeepSeek-R1-Zero。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DAPO 从 optimization 技巧角度解决 entropy collapse。CED reward 从 reward design 层面
      防止 mode collapse——evidence quality 维度确保 reward 组内有足够 variance，
      不会出现 all-same-reward 的零梯度 prompt。DAPO 的 Dynamic Sampling 过滤 accuracy=0/1 prompt
      与我们观察到的 frac_zero_std→0.8 现象本质相同：extraction-only reward 下大量 prompt
      产生零 advantage，CED 从源头（reward 设计）而非后处理（过滤）解决这个问题。

  - title: "Dr. GRPO: Removing Optimization Bias in GRPO"
    authors: Liu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: COLM 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20783
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_analysis
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的 std 归一化引入两个 bias：(1) difficulty bias——std(r) 归一化对低 variance 组
      （全对/全错）给予过高 advantage 权重，trivial question 主导训练信号；
      (2) length bias——per-token loss 的 1/|o_i| 项使长的错误回答被 under-penalize。
      当 std(r)→0 时 advantage 爆炸或未定义，梯度数值不稳定。
      Dr. GRPO 移除 std 归一化，用无偏 Monte Carlo advantage：Ã = R(q,o_i) - mean(R)。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      与我们的实验发现高度一致：extraction-only reward 下 frac_zero_std→0.8 正是
      Dr. GRPO 分析的 difficulty bias 极端情况——大量 prompt 的所有 rollout 得到相同 F1，
      std→0 导致 advantage 异常。CED 通过增加 reward 维度天然维持 reward_std>0，
      从 reward 设计而非算法修改角度避免了 Dr. GRPO 发现的 bias。

  - title: "A Minimalist Approach to LLM Reasoning: from Rejection Sampling to Reinforce"

# === Category 6: RSFT Methodology & Theory ===

  - title: "A Minimalist Approach to LLM Reasoning: from Rejection Sampling to Reinforce"
    authors: Xiao et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2504.11343
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.11343
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: key_theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RAFT（简单 rejection sampling baseline）在数学推理上与 GRPO/PPO 表现相当。
      消融实验表明 GRPO 的主要优势来自丢弃全错 prompt 而非 reward normalization。
      提出 Reinforce-Rej，在 RAFT 基础上过滤全对和全错 sample。
      关键洞察：GRPO 和 RAFT 的核心区别在于负样本处理——GRPO 混合正负样本训练，
      RAFT 只用正样本，但 RAFT 仍能达到相当性能，说明 rejection sampling 的简单性被低估了。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      直接支持我们的设计选择：(1) RSFT 在 DocRE 上成功而 GRPO 失败，
      与该论文发现一致——rejection sampling 的 offline 特性天然避免了 catastrophic forgetting；
      (2) GRPO 主要优势来自过滤全错 prompt，这与我们 RSFT 的 reward-based filtering 机制相同；
      (3) DocRE structured output 比 math reasoning 更难用 online RL 优化，
      强化了 offline RSFT 的合理性。

  - title: "Beyond Rejection Sampling: Trajectory Fusion for Scaling Mathematical Reasoning (TrajFusion)"
    authors: Jie Deng et al.
    year: 2026

# === Category 13: Inference-Time Reranking / Best-of-N (New from 2025-05-16 scan) ===

  - title: "Is Best-of-N the Best of Them? Coverage, Scaling, and Optimality in Inference-Time Alignment"
    authors: Audrey Huang et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.21878
    category: inference_time_reranking
    role: key_baseline
    key_finding: >
      Best-of-N sampling provably suffers from reward hacking when N is large.
      提出 InferenceTimePessimism 算法，通过 pessimism in the face of uncertainty
      实现 scaling-monotonic 性能（性能不随 N 增大而退化）。
      强调 pre-trained policy 对高质量 response 的 coverage 是 BoN 成功的关键。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      直接对应 CED reranker 的理论基础。CED 作为 inference-time reward model 选择最佳候选，
      该论文的 pessimism 原则可指导 CED reranker 的 threshold 设计——
      避免过度信任 CED score 导致 reward hacking。

  - title: "Inference-Time Reward Hacking in Large Language Models"
    authors: Yiwei Chen et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025 Spotlight
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.19248
    category: inference_time_reranking
    role: related_analysis
    key_finding: >
      证明 BoN 中 true reward 先升后降的 hacking pattern 是所有 inference-time 机制的固有属性。
      提出 Best-of-Poisson (BoP) 高效近似最优 reward-KL tradeoff policy，
      以及 HedgeTune 自动寻找最优 inference-time 参数。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      CED reranker 本质上是 inference-time 对齐。此论文警示：
      即使 CED score 是高质量 reward，过度优化（选 N 过大）仍可能退化。
      HedgeTune 的思路可用于自动选择 CED reranker 的最优 N。

  - title: "Inference-Aware Fine-Tuning for Best-of-N Sampling in Large Language Models"
    authors: Yinlam Chow et al.
    year: 2024
    venue: ICLR 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.15287
    category: inference_time_reranking
    role: method_component
    key_finding: >
      提出 inference-aware fine-tuning 范式：训练时直接优化 BoN inference 策略的性能。
      设计 imitation learning 和 RL 方法克服 BoN 中不可微的 argmax 操作。
      BoN-aware 模型隐式学习 exploration-exploitation meta-strategy，
      交替生成最优 response 和多样性 response。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      FREIGE 的 RSFT+CED reranker 是 train-then-rerank 两阶段。
      此论文暗示更优方案：将 CED reranker 信号直接融入训练目标，
      使模型生成 BoN-aware 的多样输出而非事后选择。

  - title: "Evaluation of Best-of-N Sampling Strategies for Language Model Alignment"
    authors: Yuki Ichihara et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: TMLR 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.12668
    category: inference_time_reranking
    role: evaluation
    key_finding: >
      系统评估 BoN 采样的 reward hacking 问题。
      提出 Stochastic Regularized BoN (SRBoN) 有理论保证的方法。
      发现简单的 Sentence Length Regularized BoN 也能获得 comparable 性能。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      CED reranker 的 regularization 策略参考。
      FREIGE 中 CED score 作为 evidence quality proxy，
      可借鉴 SRBoN 的正则化思路防止 CED reranker over-optimize evidence 而牺牲 extraction quality。

  - title: "Regularized Best-of-N Sampling with Minimum Bayes Risk Objective for Language Model Alignment"
    authors: Yuu Jinnai et al.
    year: 2024
    venue: NAACL 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.01054
    category: inference_time_reranking
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      MBR-BoN：用 Minimum Bayes Risk 目标作为 proximity regularizer 缓解 reward hacking。
      MBR 目标量化 response 与 reference policy 的接近程度。
      在 AlpacaFarm 和 hh-rlhf 上优于 vanilla BoN 和 MBR decoding。
    relevance_to_freige: >
      CED reranker 可借鉴 MBR 正则化——在选择最高 CED score 候选时，
      同时考虑候选与 base policy 的接近程度，防止选择过度偏离 extraction pattern 的输出。

  # === Category 14: RSFT Methodology Advances (New from 2025-05-16 scan) ===

I found comprehensive information about RAFT (Reward rAnked FineTuning). Here are the key findings:

## Overview
RAFT is a new framework designed to align generative models effectively, serving as an alternative to traditional RLHF approaches.

## Core Algorithm
RAFT iteratively alternates among three steps: 1) sample a batch of samples from the generative models; 2) use the reward function to score the samples and filter them to get a filtered subset of high rewards; and 3) improve the generative models by fine-tuning on the filtered subset.

## Top-K Selection
For each sampled prompt, RAFT generates multiple candidate outputs, ranks them using a learned reward model, and then fine-tunes the model using only top-ranked responses.

## Data Quality and Noise Issues
An important finding in the documentation addresses noise in the training data: At the first iteration, the initial checkpoint will occasionally include # in the response and it tends out that a random # is not detected by the reward function, which means that the response containing # can also have a high reward and be chosen into the training set. Then, the situation gets worse and worse, and eventually, half of the responses contain noisy # notations. To alleviate this problem, samples can be discarded if they contain # by assigning a large negative reward to it.

## Advantages Over PPO
The proposed framework is based on SFT-like training and offers enhanced stability and robustness compared to conventional-RL-based PPO, and RAFT decouples data generation from model updates (off-policy), enabling usage of larger batches and more memory-efficient training.

I found comprehensive research on reward hacking and RLHF. Here are the key findings related to best-of-N selection, N sensitivity, reward hacking, and training data in RLHF from 2024-2025:

## Best-of-N Sampling and Reward Hacking

Best-of-N sampling (BoN) is a technique used in RLHF frameworks, and recent research has explored its sensitivity to reward hacking. Inference-time hacking occurs when overselecting based on noisy or adversarial proxy rewards at decode time leads to a collapse of alignment performance as selection pressure increases.

Research published in 2025 asks "Is best-of-n the best of them?" in the context of coverage, scaling, and optimality in inference-time alignment, suggesting that the effectiveness of best-of-N sampling with varying N values is an active area of investigation.

## Training Data Quality and Reward Hacking

The reliability and generalization ability of a reward model are fundamentally limited by the quality of its training data, with substantial label noise, ambiguity, and misannotation identified in widely used datasets such as HH-RLHF, motivating the development of thoroughly cleaned alternatives.

## Recent Mitigation Approaches (2024-2025)

Several recent papers address reward hacking mitigation:

- Regularized best-of-n sampling with minimum Bayes risk objective has been proposed to mitigate reward hacking
- In RLHF on LLMs, monotonic increase in final-layer energy loss characterizes reward hacking, with excessive energy loss correlating with degraded contextual relevance
- Recent approaches such as dynamic labeling (POWER-DL) and preference-based reward repair (PBRR) offer scalable fixes for limited annotation regimes

Based on the search results, I found several relevant papers addressing aspects of your query about best-of-N training data selection and quality degradation issues:

## Key Findings:

**Best-of-N and Quality Degradation:**
The best-of-N approach can be extended to a step-level version, enabling exploration and selection at each step of image generation. However, the search results reveal important challenges with this approach.

**Reward Model as Imperfect Proxy:**
When training steps are excessive, models exhibit reward hacking where the reward metric continues to improve while generated image quality degrades, stemming from misalignment between the reward model and human preferences. This directly addresses the issue of reward models being imperfect proxies for quality.

**Noise Accumulation:**
Noise can be classified as either static (applied in post-processing without affecting future computation) or dynamic (accumulates as chains of thought are constructed, affecting future computation state values). Additionally, accumulation of noise results in a significant shift in the parameter space when models use replayed samples to consolidate learned knowledge, potentially causing sharp collapse in model performance.

**Selection Strategy Trade-offs:**
A higher threshold in selection tends to sample win-lose pairs with more pronounced differences, improving training sample quality but reducing quantity, while a lower threshold increases sample numbers but may introduce noisy samples.

The research indicates that as N increases in best-of-N selection, the reward model's imperfections become more influential, and noise accumulates, progressively degrading the quality of selected data.

Based on the provided PDF content, I can identify the following relevant findings:

## Key Ablation Studies

**Sample Size Analysis:**
The paper investigates how the number of selected samples (k) impacts rejection tuning effectiveness. The research examines performance across different selection quantities to determine optimal training configurations.

**Quality vs. Quantity Tradeoff:**
The authors document findings showing that including lower-ranked samples introduces noise that can degrade training quality. This suggests a meaningful relationship between selection threshold stringency and final model performance.

**Threshold Effects:**
The work establishes that downstream performance correlates with the selection threshold used during sample filtering. More restrictive thresholds (fewer samples) appear to produce cleaner training signals, though potentially with reduced data volume.

**Training Stability:**
The ablation reveals that increasing selected sample count beyond optimal levels does not monotonically improve outcomes, indicating diminishing returns and potential negative effects from noisy lower-quality examples.

The paper demonstrates these findings through systematic experimental variation, establishing empirical guidelines for practitioners selecting rejection tuning hyperparameters.

# RAFT Paper: Top-K Selection Analysis

## 1. Ablation on Number of Top-K Samples

The paper conducts experiments with **K ∈ {8, 16, 32}** to evaluate how sample count affects performance:

- **K=8**: Achieves reward of 2.180
- **K=16**: Achieves reward of 2.251
- **K=32**: Achieves reward of 2.329 (best performance)

Results show "as K increases, the obtained model tends to achieve a higher test reward" with consistent diversity metrics across all settings.

## 2. Filtering Threshold Definition

The paper employs **local ranking per prompt** rather than absolute thresholds. For each prompt, the method "sample[s] K responses from the model and take[s] the response with the highest reward." This means selecting the **top-1 sample** from K candidates per prompt, establishing an implicit 1/K acceptance ratio.

## 3. Impact of Increasing K on Training Quality

The theoretical justification shows that reward improvement follows: "larger K leads to better performance" with marginal benefits following "log K" scaling. Practically:

- Larger K requires more inference time (5-7 hours for K ∈ {8,32})
- K=16 and K=32 converge in 10-12 iterations versus 15-18 for K=8
- Trade-off: "balance the training cost and model performance"

## 4. Data Quality vs. Quantity Trade-Off

The paper doesn't explicitly analyze noise accumulation but notes that diversity metrics remain "never worse" with higher K values, suggesting quality preservation despite increased sampling.

content.thinking:
This is a critical finding from the RAFT paper. RAFT always selects the **top-1** from K candidates. So when K increases (8→16→32), they're still only taking the best 1 out of K - meaning higher K gives a better top-1 sample (the "best of more choices"). This is different from our experiment where we varied k as the number of samples to *keep* (top_k=1 vs top_k=3).

The key distinction:
- **RAFT**: Generates K candidates, selects top-1. Increasing K → better top-1 → better results. (Performance increases with K)


- **Our experiment (CED RSFT top_k)**: Generates candidates, selects top-k samples. Increasing k from 1 to 3 → keeps more (lower quality) samples → worse results. (Performance decreases with k)

This is exactly the noise accumulation problem. When you keep top-3 instead of top-1, the 2nd and 3rd best candidates are noisier and lower quality, which dilutes the training signal. I should check what Huang et al. found about BoN hacking and how increasing selection quantity from a BoN set degrades quality, then synthesize these insights into the artifact.

# Top-k Ablation Negative Result: Literature Context

## 实验背景

CED RSFT top_k ablation 结果为 negative：
- top_k=3: rel_f1=0.4454, ign_f1=0.4364
- top_k=1: rel_f1≈0.46
- 增加 k 引入更多噪声训练样本，降低关系抽取精度

## 文献中的共识

### 1. RAFT 框架的关键设计：top-1 selection from K candidates

RAFT (Dong et al., TMLR 2024) 定义了 RSFT 的标准框架：每轮生成 K 个 response，用 reward model 排序，**始终只取 top-1** 做 SFT。论文的 ablation 显示 K∈{8,16,32} 时性能随 K 增加而提升（K=8→2.180, K=16→2.251, K=32→2.329），但这是因为更大的候选池提供了更好的 top-1 样本——而非保留更多样本训练。

这恰好与我们的实验形成对照：
- **RAFT 的 K**：候选池大小，增大→更好的 top-1→性能提升
- **我们的 top_k**：保留样本数，增大→引入次优样本→性能下降

RAFT 隐式地做出了 "只用最好的 1 个" 的设计选择，我们的 ablation 从实验角度验证了这个选择的合理性。

### 2. Best-of-N 文献：N 增大导致 reward hacking

literature_map.yaml 中 Category 13 收录了 4 篇直接相关论文：

- **Huang et al. (ICML 2025)** "Is Best-of-N the Best of Them?"：证明 BoN 在 N 增大时 provably suffers from reward hacking——proxy reward 持续改善但 true reward 先升后降。根本原因是 reward model 作为不完美代理，选择压力越大，over-optimization 越严重。
- **Chen et al. (NeurIPS 2025 Spotlight)** "Inference-Time Reward Hacking"：true reward 的先升后降是所有 inference-time 选择机制的固有属性，提出 BoP 和 HedgeTune 缓解。
- **Ichihara et al. (TMLR 2025)**：系统评估 BoN reward hacking，提出 SRBoN 正则化方法。
- **Jinnai et al. (NAACL 2025)**：MBR-BoN 用 proximity regularizer 约束选择偏离度。

虽然这些论文讨论的是 inference-time reranking，但核心机制完全适用于 training-time data selection：**当 reward model（此处为 CED score）不完美时，选择更多样本放大了 proxy-true reward 的 misalignment**。

### 3. 训练数据噪声的放大效应

- **DART-Math (NeurIPS 2024)**：在数学推理 rejection tuning 中发现，放宽选择阈值（保留更多样本）增加数据量但引入噪声，downstream 性能非单调——存在 sweet spot。
- **AdaSTaR (NeurIPS 2025)**：指出 RFT 的随机采样导致已解决样本被过度训练、困难样本训练不足，进一步论证了 naive top-k 扩大选择集的问题。
- **RLHF Book (Nathan Lambert)**：指出 rejection sampling 中 "more completions can improve the best available sample, but only if the reward model can separate good and bad answers"——隐含条件是 reward model 必须足够准确，否则扩大选择集只是放大噪声。

### 4. 对 CED top_k=3 negative result 的解释

综合文献，我们的 negative result 可归因于两个交互因素：

1. **CED score 作为不完美 proxy**：CED 用 NLI entailment 评估 evidence quality，但 evidence quality 与 relation extraction correctness 并非完全对齐。top_k=1 时只取 CED 最高分的样本，proxy 偏差影响小；top_k=3 时第 2、3 名样本的 CED score 更可能 reward-hack——evidence 看起来好但 RE triple 有误。

2. **噪声稀释训练信号**：即使第 2、3 名样本不是 reward hacking，它们客观上也是次优样本。将它们与最优样本混合训练，稀释了每个 prompt 的训练信号强度，等价于在 SFT loss 中引入 label noise。

## 建议

### 不需要加入 literature_map.yaml 的论文
上述关键论文（Huang et al., Chen et al., Ichihara et al., Jinnai et al., DART-Math, AdaSTaR）**已全部收录**在 literature_map.yaml 中。

### 可考虑补充的论文
- Nathan Lambert, *RLHF Book*, Chapter 9: Rejection Sampling (https://rlhfbook.com/c/09-rejection-sampling) — 作为 practitioner guide 补充，讨论了 completion 数量与 reward model 分辨力的交互，但无实验数据，优先级低。

### 写作建议
在论文 ablation section 中报告 top_k 结果时，可引用 Huang et al. (2025) 的 BoN reward hacking 理论和 RAFT 的 top-1 design choice 作为文献支撑，论证 "CED scoring 的最优 k=1 与 BoN 文献中 reward over-optimization 的发现一致"。

- **RLHF Book (Nathan Lambert)**：指出 rejection sampling 中 "more completions can improve the best available sample, but only if the reward model can separate good and bad answers"——隐含条件是 reward model 必须足够准确，否则扩大选择集只是放大噪声。

### 4. 对 CED top_k=3 negative result 的解释

综合文献，我们的 negative result 可归因于两个交互因素：

1. **CED score 作为不完美 proxy**：CED 用 NLI entailment 评估 evidence quality，但 evidence quality 与 relation extraction correctness 并非完全对齐。top_k=1 时只取 CED 最高分的样本，proxy 偏差影响小；top_k=3 时第 2、3 名样本的 CED score 更可能 reward-hack——evidence 看起来好但 RE triple 有误。

2. **噪声稀释训练信号**：即使第 2、3 名样本不是 reward hacking，它们客观上也是次优样本。将它们与最优样本混合训练，稀释了每个 prompt 的训练信号强度，等价于在 SFT loss 中引入 label noise。

## 建议

### 不需要加入 literature_map.yaml 的论文
上述关键论文（Huang et al., Chen et al., Ichihara et al., Jinnai et al., DART-Math, AdaSTaR）**已全部收录**在 literature_map.yaml 中。

### 可考虑补充的论文
- Nathan Lambert, *RLHF Book*, Chapter 9: Rejection Sampling (https://rlhfbook.com/c/09-rejection-sampling) — 作为 practitioner guide 补充，讨论了 completion 数量与 reward model 分辨力的交互，但无实验数据，优先级低。

### 写作建议
在论文 ablation section 中报告 top_k 结果时，可引用 Huang et al. (2025) 的 BoN reward hacking 理论和 RAFT 的 top-1 design choice 作为文献支撑，论证 "CED scoring 的最优 k=1 与 BoN 文献中 reward over-optimization 的发现一致"。
